svg.text: Why the lab result interpreter is your first product
Peter Thiel rule: go from 0 to 1. Build one thing that's 10x better than anything else for that problem.
The 3-tier system (child / patient / doctor explanation levels) is your 0→1 insight. No competitor does this today.
